sources.finding: V4 has a permissionless adapter for moving accrued revenue into the TokenJar. Mainnet adapter is0x89a5d5bf00a27d55c02951e49078a5c5771051db. Source descriptions do not prove historical runtime or a profitable release.
Mainnet table agrees on adapter, existing Jar and Firepit addresses. Configuration is checked at the fresh canonical state.

POOL_MANAGER and TOKEN_JAR are immutable getters. Public collect loops currency/amount tuples and calls manager.collectProtocolFees with Jar as recipient, emitting FeesCollected. It has no return value and no caller ownership restriction. Fee updates and administrative setters are separate. A successful discarded call does not provide per-currency output amounts or cash.

protocolFeesAccrued maps currency to uint256. Only protocolFeeController may collect. Requested amount0 means the entire accrued balance, which is deducted before transfer. A synced non-native currency blocks collection. Unlike V3 there is no one-unit retention rule here. These source formulas do not establish runtime equivalence or ERC20 transfer behavior.
CollectParams has address-backed Currency and uint256 amount. ABI collect((address,uint256)[]) is void. FeesCollected has indexed currency and unindexed uint256 amount.
Tool returned Internal Error; no deployment fact obtained. Do not assume a manager address from memory. Query adapter getter once and validate its controller at the same canonical state.

scope: The prior release selects20assets, including native currency; fixed exploratory cohort, not whole-protocol coverage. LP and old V3 samples are not combined with this fresh state. No fee-setting transaction, release, order or key is involved.
